messages:
maria: incident bot paged me for Aurora prod - p99 latency spike across dedicated pool A (single-tenant). investigating.
inc-bot: INCIDENT ALERT
- service: inference-runtime
- severity: P1
- symptom: p99 latency > 3s for tenant aurora-prod across routes /v1/chat and /v1/stream
- triggered at: 2026-03-14T17:11:16Z
- page: #eng-oncall
maria: grabbing oncall
devon: I'm oncall. seeing an alert too. any initial telemetry? p95/p99 numbers?
maria: Grafana panels: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 4.6s for last 10m. error rate stable. streaming stalls = multiple client reconnects reported. tail latency clustered on sessions with very long prompt tokens (~12k tokens) + high concurrency from a single API key.
lee: Aurora support ticket shows a batch of users hitting a burst of long-prompt summarizations concurrently (20+ concurrent connections). looks like KV cache thrash + big mem pressure.
sanjay: confirming, I can see continuous-batching queue depth spiking and several inflight kv cache miss storms on nodes gpu-pool-a-*. CPU on host not saturated but GPU memory high -> hosts going into swap regen? logs attached.
maria: past hour top-line metrics: throughput stable, but token-generation latency per-token jumps when seq_len > 8k. streaming stalls correlate with long initial response generation time (cold kv cache).
devon: immediate mitigations we can try:
- throttle per-tenant concurrency (soft limit)
- enable small-model fallback for aurora-prod (e.g., go from redwood-mb-30b to 7b-quant) for new requests
- disable streaming for long prompts and return non-streaming responses
- scale up dedicated pool A by adding one node
which do we want now? I'm happy to take ownership of the canary fallback.
maria: page ops to scale pool? @ops-bot can you trigger scale +1 on gpu-pool-a
ops-bot: received scale request: adding 1 node to gpu-pool-a. ETA ~ 4 minutes. will report when node ready.
lee: meanwhile I ran a quick query on logs to find offending API key and session patterns:
```
SELECT api_key, count(*) as c, avg(seq_len) from requests
WHERE tenant='aurora' and time>now()-15m
GROUP BY api_key ORDER BY c desc limit 5;
```
result: api_key=AuroraWeb-Prod-345 accounted for 62% of long-prompt requests, avg_seq_len=11840
sanjay: that matches Aurora engineering message they rolled a new client with long history serialization yesterday. they're hitting us with very long prefixes + high concurrency (>30) which our prefix cache doesn't like.
devon: OK step 1: apply emergency tenant-level concurrency limit to 8 for api_key=AuroraWeb-Prod-345 and return 429 for excess. I'll create a temporary routing policy. pushing now.
devon: command:
```
redwoodctl routing set-tenant-limiter --tenant aurora --api-key AuroraWeb-Prod-345 --concurrency 8 --ttl 10m
```
maria: executed, gateway logs show 429s for excess connections starting +15s
lee: also toggled prefix-cache aggressive mode for pool A (reduce cache churn) - applied flag: `--kv-cache-policy=sticky`
sanjay: node scale completed. new node joined gpu-pool-a at 17:16:40Z
ops-bot: scale completed: gpu-pool-a +1 node (node-id: gpua-06)
maria: After concurrency limit + scale + cache policy changes: p95 down to 360ms, p99 down to 1.9s. streaming reconnects dropped by ~70% per Sentry events. good short-term improvement.
devon: we should still do a canary fallback to 7b on new sessions to further reduce tail behavior. I'll create a rollout that redirects 20% of aurora-new-session requests to redwood-lite-7b.
devon: rollout command:
```
redwoodctl rollout create --tenant aurora --route /v1/chat --from redwood-mb-30b --to redwood-lite-7b --percent 20 --duration 30m
```
maria: started the rollout at 17:20:12Z. telemetry will be in /dash/aurora/rollouts.
lee: posted quick note to Aurora SRE slack channel and asked them to reduce client-side concurrency for now + revisit prompt history trimming. they acknowledged and applying a client patch to truncate past context to 6k tokens.
aurora-sys: (external) thanks for the quick action. we'll patch client within 1 hour and report back. current short-term mitigation is acceptable.
sanjay: action items:
- short (now): concurrency limit for offending API key (done), scale +1 (done), sticky kv-cache (done)
- mid (30m): 20% canary fallback to 7b (running), monitor p99 for 30m
- long: add tenant-level streaming heuristics to auto-disable streaming on >8k prompt or >10s initial token delay, and add automated per-tenant rate-limit when token-length distribution spikes
maria: creating incident ticket with timeline and mitigation steps, will handoff to oncall rotation in 45m for monitoring and RCA. tagging @devon as primary for follow-ups.
devon: I'll keep monitor until handoff. I'll post a final status update when we see stable p99 < 1s for 30m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: observed no new config regressions. no deployments in the last 2 hours.
maria: leaving a short checklist for RCA:
- collect heap / gpu mem timelines for pool A from 16:40 -> 18:00
- capture prefix cache hit/miss rates pre/post sticky flag
- sample request traces for 50 p99 requests
- correlate client rollout times from Aurora support ticket
- recommend product change: per-tenant prompt length soft-stop at API gateway
lee: noted. I'll start fetching traces and will upload to incident doc.
devon: initial status: mitigation effective. p99 at 18:12: 0.85s. moving to monitoring mode. will handoff in 45m unless regresses.
maria: thanks everyone. tagging eng-oncall for monitoring: @devon now active oncall. I'll update the ticket and close this Slack thread when RCA doc is ready.
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE
- status: mitigated -> monitoring
- next update: in 30m or sooner if regression
- incident id: INC-20260314-aurora-01
maria: final note to logs: encountered an edge-case where streaming keepalive frames still triggered client reconnects even after first token emitted (we should inspect websocket buffer flush behavior). adding to RCA.
lee: uploading logs + traces to incident doc: https://internal.docs/incidents/INC-20260314-aurora-01
sanjay: leaving a postmortem action to add automated tenant hotpath detector for sudden long-prompt spikes.
devon: acknowledging. I'll create follow-up ticket for product + infra owners to implement heuristics. will ping in #product later.
maria: handoff done. last_message_ts=1854332100
